create_bulk_from_atoms: create a Bulk object by passing an ase.Atoms object directly to the constructor
create_bulk_from_db_index: create a Bulk object by selecting from the bulk database using a numeric index
create_bulk_from_src_id: create a Bulk object by selecting from the bulk database using a source id like mp-30
create_bulk_random: create a Bulk object by randomly sampling from the bulk database with no arguments
get_slabs_from_bulk: get a list of possible slabs for a bulk instance using get_slabs with max_miller parameter
